name: rally.raid Earth GPS
description: Rally raid navigation GPS and rally computer for BeamNG.Earth stages: CAP, trip / partial odometer with corrections, hidden waypoints (FIM rules), speed zones, stage clock and penalties. Its MENU button opens REPAIR (mid-stage repairs, spare wheels, suspension / radiator, bivouac time and budget, engine change, penalties: the former Repair app), RECOVER CAR, the crash RESUME, PLANNER and, in a build with rally mode, RALLY (the former Rally app, EXPERIMENTAL).
author: wyans (rally.raid Earth)
